messages:
Emma - Sales: Hey team — Acme's security team sent back a SIG/CAIQ with a bunch of KMS/BYOK questions. Can someone help draft short, clear answers? They want POC notes + rotation policy for their vendor risk review.
Alex - AcmeCorp IT: Thanks Emma. Main asks: 1) At-rest encryption details and key custody, 2) BYOK/HSM options and how we integrate, 3) Key rotation default and customer-driven rotation, 4) Evidence for vendor risk (attestations). Can we provide a single-page digest for our VRM?
Ryan - Solutions Eng: Quick answers draft: at-rest: data encrypted using envelope encryption; model artifacts and persistent storage use AES-256-GCM. KMS (customer-managed or Redwood-managed) stores DEKs; we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault. In-transit: TLS 1.2+ with strong ciphers. For BYOK: we support import of customer keys or remote-wrap via EKM/HSM; CloudHSM/YubiHSM supported via our private deployment or dedicated connectors.
Mira - Security: Add: SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA; regular third-party pen tests and vulnerability scans. We maintain key access logs in audit trail retained per customer retention policy (configurable). For CAIQ mapping: I'll attach control IDs to the answers.
Alex - AcmeCorp IT: Good. For BYOK, their risk team expects an HSM-backed key option and proof keys never leave customer control. How do we explain the remote-wrap/EKM flow?
Ryan - Solutions Eng: Short flow for VRM: "Customer key (in HSM/KMS) -> Redwood requests encrypted DEK via EKM/wrapKey API -> encrypted DEK stored by Redwood; Redwood can only use wrapped DEK and has no plaintext K for customer-managed keys."
Ryan - Solutions Eng: Example config snippet we use in POCs (pseudo):
```
redwood.kms.provider: aws
redwood.kms.key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abcd
redwood.kms.byoek: true  # uses CloudHSM/EKM wrap
redwood.kms.rotation_schedule_days: 90
```
Mira - Security: Rotation: default 90 days for DEKs; for CMKs we defer to the customer KMS rotation policy. We recommend at least quarterly rotation for DEKs if you want stronger limits. Note: rotating CMKs triggers re-wrapping steps; we provide automation and migration helpers in the POC.
Emma - Sales: Alex — would it help if we provide a 1-page summary + short annotated CAIQ mapping and a link to the POC runbook? I can send both to your VRM.
Alex - AcmeCorp IT: Yes please. Also they asked for evidence that Redwood never persists plaintext customer keys and that access is limited to a small ops role with MFA.
Mira - Security: Statement to include: "Redwood does not persist plaintext customer master keys. Plaintext DEKs are held in memory only for the lifetime needed to encrypt/decrypt and are never written to disk. Access to key operations is limited by RBAC and logged; critical ops require 2-person review for Dedicated/Private deployments."
Ryan - Solutions Eng: For the POC we can enable stricter controls: dedicated HSM cluster, key use audit streaming to the customer's SIEM (via syslog/forwarder), and time-limited credentials for the POC engineers.
tz-bot: Reminder: POC workspace for Acme created — link: https://console.redwood.ai/poc/acme-2026 (created by tz-ops), expires in 30 days.
Emma - Sales: I'll assemble the one-pager + attach Mira's CAIQ mapping. Ryan — can you drop the short how-to for BYOK/HSM into the POC runbook? Target: send to Acme VRM EOD tomorrow.
Ryan - Solutions Eng: On it, will put step-by-step and the sample commands we use for CloudHSM wrap/unwrap. Will also include the automations for CMK rotation.
Mira - Security: I'll redact and attach excerpts from SOC2 and the pen test summary (NDA required). Once the VRM signs the NDA we can send full reports.
Alex - AcmeCorp IT: Sounds good. One more: do you support CRC/hardware-backed attestation for HSM keys? We need to know if there's attestation evidence for key origin.
Ryan - Solutions Eng: Yes — for CloudHSM/Cloud provider HSMs we can provide attestation artifacts (key creation metadata, HSM certs). For on-prem HSM we can capture vendor attestation, and for YubiHSM we provide device serial and wrap proof. I'll note the exact artifacts in the runbook.
Emma - Sales: Thanks everyone — I'll compile and send the package. Alex, ping me if the VRM has follow-ups. :thumbsup:
